1.consolidated_definition: Eliminar. Borrar un archivo, programa, etc. de la computadora. Anglicismo híbrido, frecuente. El monitor externo ya lo conecté pero no tengo señal y eso se debe a que no prende —ya retiré todos los dispositivos que no son necesarios y no prende— ya le di un clear (YoReparo, PR, consultado 30-03-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Eliminar. Erase a file, program, etc. from the computer. Anglicism hybrid, frequent. The external monitor is already connected but I don't have a signal and that's because it doesn't turn on – I've removed all unnecessary devices and it still doesn't turn on – I gave it a clear (YoReparo, PR, consulted 30-03-08)
